name: @qld-gov-au/qgds-tokens
description: This repository is configured to sync tokens via Figma.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:package
scripts.build:package: tsc --build && rm -r dist/android/* && rm -r dist/css/* && rm -r dist/js/* && rm -r dist/scss/* && copyfiles -u 1 src/android/**/*.xml src/css/**/*.css src/js/**/*.js src/scss/**/*.scss dist
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run test
